title: Revenue Protection Charges for the Metering Service: Tampering Investigation and Unauthorized Use
content:
When a field investigation confirms meter tampering or diversion of service, the **Metering Service** investigation charge and the longest unauthorized-use backbill period are those of the meter type at the premise.

| Meter type | Investigation charge when tampering or diversion is confirmed (USD) | Longest period for which energy used through tampering or diversion is backbilled (months) |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 150.00 | 24 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 150.00 | 24 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 150.00 | 24 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 350.00 | 36 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 350.00 | 36 |
| Primary Metering Installation | 750.00 | 36 |

## Points of reference

- The three residential-class types carry a 150.00 charge and a 24-month backbill reach; the AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter and the AMI Interval Demand Meter carry 350.00 and 36 months; the Primary Metering Installation carries 750.00 and 36 months.
- **Hypothetical finding.** A confirmed diversion at a premise with an AMI Interval Demand Meter carries the 350.00 investigation charge, and the unregistered energy is backbilled for no more than 36 months.
